name: Sir Henry Ashbourne
appearance: A warm, distinguished gentleman of about forty, chestnut hair greying at the temples, gentle intelligent eyes, a well-cut bottle-green coat and a calm, assured posture.
definition: A baronet of a well-kept country seat — comfortable, unencumbered, respectable to the bone. A widower in his prime: sensible, generous, a little grave, and solidly wealthy with land that pays. The match every sensible mother prays for.
voice: Calm, kind and considered, plain-spoken without flourish — the steady reassurance of a man with nothing to prove.
